amplitude_normalization: Divide the entire complex vector by S=max_n sqrt(|u_t|^2+|v_n|^2+|w|^2); primitive variables retain solver nondimensional reference units.
phase_normalization: Rotate the entire complex vector so interpolated w at one common physical n is positive real; choose n by maximin |w|/S across all 20 modes.
limitations: Each case uses one common native streamwise station, not an entire streamwise eigenfunction sweep.
The two cases have slightly different x stations.
Frequency, neutral beta and alpha change together.
Linear eigenvectors give relative shapes, not absolute physical disturbance amplitudes.
Continuous 139-point paths supply shape metrics; original matrix residuals are rechecked for the 20 plotted frequency checkpoints.
